node.title: A Few Impressions from Amsterdam
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I was originally going to post something else for my 1000th node, but I'll save that for later, since I think this is fitting: As many of you probably know, [http://perlconference.amsterdam|The Perl Conference in Amsterdam] ended on Friday. It was my first Perl event, and a great experience! I was very happy to finally meet some of you in person, [choroba], [LanX], [Corion], [Tux], [Laurent_R], and [rurban], and I'm really sorry I didn't get to say bye properly since I had to leave a bit early. If I met some of you but haven't yet matched you to a username, I apologize and drop me a /msg.

I enjoyed the talks by some of the greats like [TimToady], [TheDamian], [Ovid], and [brian_d_foy], some of which are already available as [https://www.facebook.com/theperlconference/videos/|videos on Facebook] (Update: [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCd9Fs_oZBMmTUWKJKuR_qdg/videos|and YouTube], thanks [Corion]), and I hear the full videos should be online within a month or so. For my favorite funny moment of the conference: First, watch Damian Conway's talk "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e1T7WbKox6s|Three Little Words]", definitely worth it on its own (as is checking out the impressive [mod://PPR]), and then go to the Lighting Talks from Aug 10th and skip ahead [https://youtu.be/24cCjo6_sXc?t=5955|to around 1h39m15s] in the video... :-) (or with better quality on slides & audio, [https://youtu.be/EDQu0msc63E?t=4142|this link])

Update: Added direct links to the YouTube videos.

Update 2: Some pictures can be found at [http://twitter.com/TPCiA]. Also updated links to YouTube.

Update 3: Updated video links to higher-quality versions
